property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, transferOwnership(newOwner) should succeed for any non-zero newOwner (i.e. allow transferring ownership to any address including non-zero); the mutant wrongly forbids non-zero newOwner causing transferOwnership to revert whenever newOwner != address(0).
change_summary: Added a require reversing check to forbid any non-zero newOwner, only allowing transfer to zero address (effectively only allowing renounce via transferOwnership).
